apiKey.keyFor: the translation service needs an activation code entered in settings

evidence.quote: 在“设置 → FT AI版全文对照翻译”填写激活码并选择目标语言。
发起翻译时，插件会将你选择的 PDF 和激活码发送至翻译服务以创建和查询任务。

checkNote: README quote about entering the activation code in settings is real. Its other quote says the PDF and code are sent to the translation service, so translation is remote.
